'''Elli-Vaa''' was an [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and a member of the [[Umbaran Shadow Assassin]]s by the time of the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Crisis on Umbara]], Elli-Vaa led a group of Umbaran Shadow Assassins, alongside soldiers of the [[Umbaran militia|Umbaran Military]], to defend a [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]] carrying [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]]. When the train was [[Crisis on Umbara|raided]] by a group of warriors of the [[Eternal Alliance]], she intended to repel the attackers. Elli-Vaa and [[Technician/Legends|Technician]] [[Canni]] duelled [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]], [[Theron Shan]], and [[Lana Beniko]] but both were killed.<ref name="Crisis" />
